title: The project directory got a more useful map
summary:
A directory-gardening day: better project discovery, clearer Special Bee tracking, and a little more order around the edges.

KoboldAI is now featured prominently with current links and correct attribution, while MVKProject Nexus API and new Special Bee projects joined the directory. Featured-project sorting was also tightened up, because a showcase should not behave like a junk drawer.

Documentation and token tracking were added for Special Bee requests, giving contributors and project users a clearer view of how those requests work and what they consume.

Feed listener access gained authentication, making the connection point more deliberate while preserving the project’s growing ecosystem of shared tools.
